entities.summary: Yosano Hiroshi, known by his pen name Tekkan Yosano  was a Japanese author and poet active in late Meiji, Taishō, and early Shōwa era. His wife was fellow author Yosano Akiko. His grandson was politician Kaoru Yosano.
